scenes.narration: Most people prepare for an interview by memorizing answers. But three small mistakes can make a good candidate look unprepared.
First, ignoring the job description. Highlight the skills they actually ask for, and match each one with a real achievement.
Second, speaking without a structure. Try this: describe the situation, the action you took, and the result.
Third, forgetting your own questions. Ask what success looks like in the first ninety days. Show that you think beyond getting hired.
Preparation is more than practice. Know the role, tell clear stories, and ask meaningful questions. Save this for your next interview.
